__comment: Landmark positions on the four Act 1 plates (D21), read off the shipped 2400x2400 files. x and y are fractions of the plate's width and height (0 = left/top), aimed at the landmark's base or clearing, where a node should sit. D25: every landmark here gets a node in its map's M3 layout; a map may add more nodes, never fewer. `what` describes the drawing only: it is not a place name and not canon (names come from T's rulings in the story overview). `edge` marks a landmark where a road leaves the plate. The coast marks are the 44 node positions of T's Chapter 1 board (v4, braindump/2026-10-28-breakwater-chapter-1-map.md), read from T's sketch (BW1b).
